scenes.action: The Planner reveals a complicated plan on a wall map while Rookie nods too confidently.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Every second of this plan matters. Rookie: Absolutely. I understood at least... the map.
scenes.caption: THE PLAN IS PERFECT. THE ROOKIE? NOT SO MUCH.

scenes.action: Rookie turns the map upside down and gives a proud thumbs-up. The Planner freezes in disbelief.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Why is the map upside down? Rookie: To surprise the guards.
scenes.caption: STEP ONE: CONFUSE EVERYONE. INCLUDING YOURSELF.

scenes.action: Rookie sneaks dramatically along a quiet street, but waves cheerfully at a suspicious guard.
scenes.dialogue: Guard: What are you doing here? Rookie: Practising being invisible.
scenes.caption: STEALTH LEVEL: ABSOLUTELY ZERO.

scenes.action: The team reaches a grand fictional bank entrance. Rookie proudly presses a doorbell instead of the secret signal.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: That was not the signal. Rookie: It made a very convincing beep.
scenes.caption: THE HEIST HAS OFFICIALLY GONE OFF SCRIPT.
